name: Repercussion of the Golden Witch
source:
Three years ago Ushiromiya George was killed during the annual family gathering. Now the Ushiromiya family gets back together again to celebrate Christmas and to, maybe, close the wounds of the past. However, the culprit is among them and before the night comes, a murder will happen once more.
It's time for Kinjo, the son of the famed detective Gilligan Goldbar, to unearth the truth and bring the murderer to justice.
translation:
三年前，右代宫乔治在一年一度的家族聚会中被杀。如今，右代宫家族再次团聚，庆祝圣诞节，也或许想抚平过去留下的伤痕。然而，凶手就在他们之中；夜幕降临前，杀人事件将再次发生。

是时候让名侦探吉利根·戈德巴尔之子金城揭开真相，将凶手绳之以法。
